After the peak, the line declines to 28.40 at $\alpha$ = 0.7 and continues to drop, ending at a BLEU score of approximately 28.12 when $\alpha$ is 0.9.

The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 28.0 to 28.5, marked at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays a single solid blue line with circular markers. The line starts at a $p$ value of 0.05 with a BLEU score of approximately 28.31. It rises to reach a peak of approximately 28.53 at $p$ = 0.15. The line then declines to 28.42 at $p$ = 0.25, rises slightly to 28.47 at $p$ = 0.35, and finally decreases to end at a BLEU score of approximately 28.43 when $p$ is 0.45.
